name: General Mills Rice Chex Cereal (Crisp Puffed Rice Lattice)
whyItWorks: Delicate woven lattices of puffed white rice and sugar with zero gluten and only 1g fiber. They absorb milk rapidly and disintegrate into a soft, non-abrasive mash with minimal chewing.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Serve with lactose-free milk or eat dry straight from the box as a clean finger-food snack.
watchOuts: Certified gluten-free; safe for both active flares and remission.
